dedupe_keys.name: zonas de servicio portuarias de espana

description: Zonas de servicio portuarias de España is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Puertos del Estado. The port service areas include cartographic and alphanumeric information on the land service area and water zones I and II. Coverage: Puertos del Estado. The portal shows the English title as "Spanish port service area" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Puertos del Estado. Its keywords include IDEE, Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales, Zona de servicio terrestre, Port Area, Puertos, Fairway Area. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
